blocks.md: The tooltip is displayed on top by default but you can change it with the `data-placement` attribute.

blocks.label: Tooltip placement example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Tooltip placement example" class="component" id="tooltip-placement"><main class="grid"><button data-tooltip="Top">Top</button><button data-placement="right" data-tooltip="Right">Right</button><button data-placement="bottom" data-tooltip="Bottom">Bottom</button><button data-placement="left" data-tooltip="Left">Left</button></main></article>
blocks.code:
<button data-tooltip="Top">Top</button>
<button data-tooltip="Right" data-placement="right">Right</button>
<button data-tooltip="Bottom" data-placement="bottom">Bottom</button>
<button data-tooltip="Left" data-placement="left">Left</button>
